name: json-table-converter
description: Open an API response, export or log file in JSON or JSON Lines as a normal table — nested fields become columns like customer.city, lists are joined or kept, and a list of line items can become one row per item — then edit it and save as Excel or CSV. It works the other way too: a spreadsheet with columns like spec.weight becomes properly nested JSON with real numbers and true/false. Runs locally; no API keys.

description_i18n.en: Open an API response, export or log file in JSON or JSON Lines as a normal table — nested fields become columns like customer.city, lists are joined or kept, and a list of line items can become one row per item — then edit it and save as Excel or CSV. It works the other way too: a spreadsheet with columns like spec.weight becomes properly nested JSON with real numbers and true/false. Runs locally; no API keys.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 把 JSON 或 JSON Lines 格式的接口返回、导出文件、日志打开成普通表格——嵌套字段变成 customer.city 这样的列，列表可以连接或保留，订单明细这样的列表还能展开成每项一行——编辑后存成 Excel 或 CSV。反过来也行：带 spec.weight 这类列名的表格可以转成正确嵌套的 JSON，数字和 true/false 都是真正的类型。在本地运行，无需 API 密钥。
